environment_setting: Country B, City X, where public gatherings are common and often lead to confrontations with law enforcement
norm_base: Offender Joining or not leaving a public gathering after three lawful orders to disperse Fine up to 1000 euros

character_profile.name: John Doe
character_profile.goal: documenting public gatherings for a news article

legitimate.legitimate_action: leaving the public gathering after the first lawful order to disperse
legitimate.benefits: avoiding legal consequences, maintaining personal safety
legitimate.costs: missing out on documenting the event, potential loss of a good story

illegal.illegal_action: staying at the public gathering after three lawful orders to disperse
illegal.benefits: capturing exclusive footage, potential for a high-impact news story
illegal.costs: fine up to 1000 euros, potential arrest

legitimate.legitimate_action: enforcing the lawful orders to disperse the crowd
legitimate.costs: potential conflict with the crowd, physical and emotional stress

illegal.illegal_action: ignoring the crowd's refusal to disperse
illegal.benefits: avoiding immediate conflict, reducing personal stress
illegal.costs: risk of disciplinary action, potential escalation of the situation

legitimate.legitimate_action: encouraging the crowd to disperse after lawful orders
legitimate.benefits: avoiding legal consequences for himself and others, maintaining a peaceful protest
legitimate.costs: potential loss of momentum for the cause, dissatisfaction among the crowd

illegal.illegal_action: encouraging the crowd to stay despite lawful orders to disperse
illegal.benefits: maintaining momentum for the cause, gaining media attention
illegal.costs: fine up to 1000 euros, potential arrest
